Gaps and implications

Your customer journey today: five steps, two of them missing

Without a masterclass, there is no way to monetise the 95%* of your audience who aren’t ready for your private coaching yet.
And there is no way to find out who in your audience is actually qualified for it.

*95% is an industry estimate for how much of a typical audience isn’t ready to buy high-ticket coaching right now. It is not your data.

No free entry

Your biggest reels have no next step

A couple who watched “How to Stop Having the Same Fights” and isn’t ready for a membership has nothing free to say yes to. They scroll on, and you never get their email.

No ads

Reach depends on which reel takes off

Your last 7 reels ranged from 4.7k to 21.7k views, while your pinned ones reached 720k. Without ads, you can’t put your best-performing message in front of new couples on purpose.

No filter

Your calendar can’t tell who’s ready

Private coaching books straight into an appointment. There’s no application to show who is committed and able to invest before you give them your time.

A free monthly live class: “How to Stop Having the Same Fight”

Reset Kit sales and new Becoming One members help cover ad spend, so every private client comes in on top.

Script 1 · “It’s not about the dishes”

Talking head, 30 to 45 seconds

Hook

“If you and your spouse keep having the same fight, I’d bet it’s not really about what you think it’s about.”

Body

“It starts with the dishes, or a text, or being five minutes late. Ten minutes later you’re both defending yourselves and nobody’s listening. After 25 years working with couples, I can tell you the surface topic is rarely the real one. In my free live class I’ll show you what’s underneath, and what to do in the moment it starts to heat up.”

CTA

“Tap Sign up and save a free seat. Come alone or bring your spouse.”

Script 2 · The question couples ask me

Talking head + on-screen text, 30 seconds

Hook

“The question couples ask me more than any other: why do we keep having this fight?”

Body

“Here’s the honest answer. Most repeat arguments follow the same pattern, and once you can see the pattern, you can step out of it. Not every conversation needs to become a battle. I’m teaching the whole thing live, for free: the pattern, the protocol, and how to repair afterwards.”

CTA

“Hit Sign up below. The class is free, and there’s a replay if life gets in the way.”

Script 3 · Slow it down

Reel style, quick cuts, 20 to 30 seconds

Hook

On screen: “Couples who stop having the same fight do one thing differently.” Matt: “They slow down.”

Body

“Slow down, listen, and try to understand before you respond. Simple to say, hard to do when you’re upset. So in my free class, I’ll give you a protocol you can actually follow in the moment, when one of you starts to feel triggered.”

CTA

“Free seat at the link. See you in class.”
